name: Motorized Personal Mobility Device
description: An all-electric vehicle for carrying people, on at least one wheel and with no closed cabin (appareil de transport personnel motorisé): an electric kick scooter, a self-balancing vehicle, or a scooter-like one with a seat or three wheels, with motors totalling 500 W or less that stop propelling it at 25 km/h.

restrictions.rule: Allowed on public highways only under a pilot project, in force since July 20, 2023, which replaced the earlier electric scooter pilots
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 1, 50, 51

restrictions.rule: Electric motors only, totalling 500 W or less, that stop propelling it at 25 km/h
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 2, 4

restrictions.rule: Weighs 36 kg or less including the battery, on wheels at least 190 mm in diameter
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 5, 6

restrictions.rule: Not a motorcycle, moped, power-assisted bicycle, motorized mobility aid, motorized toy or off-highway vehicle
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, s. 2

restrictions.rule: A brake on every wheel, and except for a self-balancing vehicle two braking systems on separate controls, at least one mechanical and hand-operated if it has handlebars
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 7, 8

restrictions.rule: Front and rear reflectors, and a white front light and red rear light on at night, unless the rider wears equivalents
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 10, 12, 25

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 14 or older and carry proof of age
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, s. 16

restrictions.rule: Every rider must wear a fastened protective helmet; one without hand grips, such as a self-balancing vehicle, also needs elbow and knee pads, full-finger gloves and closed shoes
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 17, 18

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on a public highway with a speed limit over 50 km/h, except to cross it or on a separated bike lane
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, s. 19

restrictions.rule: Ridden under the rules for cyclists: no sidewalks unless allowed, no earphones, no passengers, and no trailers or towing
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, ss. 20, 23, 27, 31

restrictions.rule: Whoever maintains a road may ban it from a bike lane or road with a sign
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, s. 33

restrictions.rule: Not a road vehicle: no registration or driver's licence
restrictions.citation: Pilot project concerning the use of motorized personal mobility devices, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 39.1.002, s. 3
